name: 風靈先知
rulesText: ① 召喚時：從牌組頂部公開3張卡片，從中選擇一張「風靈先知」以外名字帶有"風靈"的卡片，加入手牌，其餘按喜好順序放置牌組底部

en.name: Wind Spirit Prophet
en.rulesText: ① When summoned: reveal the top 3 cards of your deck, choose a card among them whose name contains "Wind Spirit" other than Wind Spirit Prophet and add it to your hand, and put the rest on the bottom of the deck in any order.
